name: orthodenticle homeobox 2
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: OTX2 encodes homeobox protein OTX2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic microphthalmia type 5 (autosomal dominant).
